text.label: p · A development partner should be able to explain how business requireme
text.value: A development partner should be able to explain how business requirements become a working product. Compare the proposed process, technical scope and evidence of relevant work before making a decision.

text.label: h2 · Ask for a walkthrough of the work

text.label: p · Review how the team moved from requirements to design, implementation
text.value: Review how the team moved from requirements to design, implementation and testing. Distinguish completed client projects from illustrative concepts and forecasts from measured outcomes.
